caption_L1: Here a is a line plot titled Revenue , operating profit (EBIT) and net income of Henkel worldwide from 2006 to 2019 (in million euros). The x-axis plots Year while the y-axis plots Revenue.
caption_L2L3: Henkel had a general upward revenue growth trend from 2006 to 2019.  The revenue grew from around 13000 million euros in 2006 to 20000 million in 2019.  The only period where the revenue fell was between 2008 and 2009.  Revenue remained stable between 2012 and 2014, and again between 2017 and 2019.
